name: Carroll County, VA
findings: Carroll County has 47 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Carroll County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Carroll County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
